title: Continents and oceans
examples: How many continents are there on Earth?
Can you name all the continents for me?

explain.say: Today we learn about the big parts of Earth.
There are seven big land areas called continents.
The seven continents are Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia.

draw.text: Asia, Africa, N. America, S. America, Antarctica, Europe, Australia

explain.say: The world has five very big areas of salt water.
The biggest ocean is the Pacific Ocean, and the smallest is the Arctic Ocean.
Look at a world map to see where these land and water areas are.

faq.a: There are seven continents on Earth. You can also ask how many landmasses there are, or what the seven continents are.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth. You might also ask which ocean is the biggest, or what the largest ocean is.
Yes, Australia is both a continent and a country. You could also ask if Australia is a continent, or if Australia is land.
asks: Tell me about Australia's land status.

faq.a: The Arctic Ocean is the smallest of the five oceans. You may also ask what the smallest ocean is, or which ocean is the smallest.
asks: What is the size of the Arctic Ocean?

faq.q: Are continents all the same size?
faq.a: No, the continents are very different in size. Asia is the largest continent, and Australia is much smaller.
asks: Do all continents have the same size?
Compare the sizes of the continents.

facts: There are seven continents on Earth.
The five oceans are Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.
Antarctica is known for being the coldest continent.

quiz.why: Asia is the largest continent on Earth.

wrong.1: Africa is a large continent, but Asia is bigger.
wrong.2: North America is large, but Asia covers more land.
wrong.3: Antarctica is very large, but Asia is still bigger.

quiz.why: The Arctic Ocean is the smallest of the five major oceans.

wrong.1: The Atlantic Ocean is much bigger than the Arctic Ocean.
wrong.2: The Indian Ocean is larger than the Arctic Ocean.
wrong.3: The Southern Ocean is also larger than the Arctic Ocean.

quiz.say: If you look at a world map, which body of water is the largest?
quiz.why: The Pacific Ocean is known for being the largest ocean.

wrong.0: The Atlantic Ocean is large, but the Pacific is bigger.
wrong.1: The Indian Ocean is smaller than the Pacific Ocean.
wrong.2: The Arctic Ocean is the smallest, not the largest.
